text: Machine learning is a type of technology that helps computers learn from data. In supervised learning, a computer learns by studying training data, which includes examples and correct answers. From this data, it builds models that can recognise patterns. After training, these models can make predictions about new information they have never seen before. For example, a model can predict whether an email is spam or not. The quality of a model is measured by its accuracy, which means how often its predictions are correct. Good training data is very important because it helps the model make better predictions and achieve higher accuracy in real situations.
